description: Start a shopping task here instead of guessing search words. Returns the sixteen departments, each with the slug get_category takes and a picture. A keyword search is one guess at what somebody meant; a department is the shop's own shelf, and get_category on one hands you the brands, the filters and a page of listings in a single call. GET /api/agent/browse/categories. No wallet and no signature. Served from cache; a department whose picture has gone cold costs one call against the catalogue quota this site shares with its shoppers.
name: list_categories
title: The sixteen department doors
